fields.value: Approximately 54 bpm (conditional mean-interval estimate). Spacing is uneven, including a conspicuously short interval between the middle-right pair of retained upright peaks. Similar upright sharp complexes with one earlier middle-right event; small preceding bumps and following rounded waves. The shorter interval supports comparing premature-beat patterns, but does not select an atrial, junctional or ventricular origin. A premature atrial comparison specifically requires a demonstrably early atrial wave differing from the background atrial waves, a resolved atrial-to-ventricular sequence and the course interval criteria; these are not established here. PR remains withheld. The selected QRS uncertainty envelope crosses 0.12 s and does not establish a narrow/wide class.
